messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — SEV 2: elevated errors on external-agent-exec path (toolcall). 95p latency 5.8s, error rate 23% over 5m. Affected: a subset of hosted customers in us-west. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/agent-exec-surge

oncall_mia: taking lead. I see a big spike in queue depth on gw-node-7, and OOMs on serving-pool-2. Starting triage.

aj: looking at logs — a new model variant rollout increased KV cache traffic and caused thrashing on kernel selection. There's also a surge in long-lived fncalls from a single tenant (tenant-id: t-1192).

kevin: can we soft-disable external tool calls for the tenant(s) first? Prefer per-tenant rollback before cluster-wide.

oncall_mia: agree. Plan: 1) apply per-tenant invoke throttle 2) disable external-agent invocation for free-tier and non-enterprise 3) enable text-only fallback for impacted routes. Will run changes in that order.

sam: tagging support@ and cc @lina_support for customer comms.

oncall_mia: executing per-tenant throttle now.

oncall_mia: ```bash
# throttle API
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/v1/tenants/t-1192/actions/throttle"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"limit":5, "window_sec":60, "reason":"mitigation - agent-exec surge"}'
```

kevin: throttle applied, metrics showing request rate drop for t-1192.

oncall_mia: next: toggling feature flag to disable external exec on non-enterprise: ```json
{"feature":"external_agent_exec","scope":"non_enterprise","enabled":false}
```

aj: flag rolled out to 20% -> 100% over 30s. Latency 95p coming down to 2.1s, error rate down to 4.2%.

lina_support: FYI we've drafted a short email to affected customers; moving to send after we stabilize. Template in #support/snippets.

sam: are there tenants still impacted? we should keep targeted comms for enterprise customers if they hit degradation.

oncall_mia: two enterprise tenants (t-043, t-077) showed elevated errors; we've applied a temporary per-tenant cap and set their routes to text-only fallback. Notifying AMs.

kevin: we should record the exact toggles as a change record. oncall_mia can you paste the control-plane response IDs?

oncall_mia: change IDs: CHG-100244, CHG-100245, CHG-100246. I'll open an incident ticket and link these.

incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-4539 and paged rotations for postmortem: @oncall_mia, @aj, @kevin, @lina_support.

oncall_mia: status: mitigated (traffic shaping + per-tenant toggles). Moving to monitoring. Will keep thread updated and hand off to daytime eng lead in 40m.

aj: recommend we schedule rollout rollback window after we validate model variant behaves under lower KV pressure. Follow-up: model owner ping @ml-models.

lina_support: support will prepare customer notes for impacted accounts, ETA for detailed update ~90m.

oncall_mia: handing to @kevin for watch and customer comms handoff. If new spike, reactivate paging.

kevin: ack — taking watch. Thanks team :thumbsup:
